name: Cinematic AI worlds
look: photoreal or painterly generated environments, camera flies through, product placed in an impossible place.

fits.notes: AI image/video tools, travel, ambitious consumer brands

products: brands that need AI disclosure unless disclosed

when_not: Avoid claims it can't prove; AI worlds feel generic fast.

type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text.

colour.guidance: restrained serif or thin sans; film grade (teal-orange or desaturated).
colour.rule: Style palette fills the world; the brand colour takes the role named in brand_lock.colour_role and never drops below the contrast of the brand's own palette.

keeps: real product UI capture (composited as a screen plate, never redrawn)
brand_lock.colour_role: the grade is tinted toward the brand colour; the product placement carries the brand colour
brand_lock.type_role: restrained serif or thin sans; brand face for the claim
brand_lock.world_changes: generated worlds the camera flies through; the product is placed in an impossible place
brand_lock.rule: Under a brand lock the brand colour, type and logo stay; the style world (material, picture language, motion grammar, finish, sound) is what varies between looks. A branded launch shows 3 different style worlds.

hints: still plate to 2.5D fly-through (A1 + depth maps)
motion_grammar.note: grammars lists existing library/grammars ids; grammars_planned lists world grammars the engine plan adds (game-world, tabletop, os-desktop, type-only, editorial, collage, cinematic-world).

effects_note: rasan-fx passes (runtime/rasan-fx.js); order is the pass order. {brand_colour} / {second_ink} are filled from the brand or look palette.

codex_assets.prompt_template: {world_style_line}, cinematic wide plate of {scene}, volumetric light, film grade, no text, no logos, consistent with the anchor image

animate_with.what: camera on a plate (Ken Burns with grain and vignette)
displacement / warp (shader fed by noise or depth)

codex_assets.rules: Flat, evenly lit plain background (chroma green or pure white) for clean cut-outs; one prompt family with the same seed words; generate at 2x and downscale; never ask Codex for readable UI text or logos (typeset them in HTML).

build.recipe: Codex stills (8 to 12 per film, one `## Imagery` art-direction), depth via a monocular depth model or hand-painted mask, Three.js plane-stack with a camera spline; `volumetric-light-god-rays.md`; `one-take-through-scenes.md`. Needs an asset pipeline for depth maps (gap).

product_ui_rule: If the film shows RasanAI Studio, use the current dark sidebar UI with the Describe...Final dot stepper (docs/brand/studio-ui/), as a real capture composited INTO this style; never the retired light UI.

palettes.name: Teal and amber
palettes.words: deep teal shadows, warm bone white, amber light, teal

palettes.name: Fog blue
palettes.words: fog-blue shadows, cold white, sodium amber

palettes.name: Desert dusk
palettes.words: burnt umber black, sand white, sunset orange, dusty teal

brand_lock.rule: Brand colour is one practical light or prop in the scene (a lamp, a sign without text, a garment); the grade stays style-fixed. Never tint the whole grade to the brand colour. Slots marked brand take the brand colour (exact hex); slots marked style keep the palette value; brand-or-style takes the brand colour only when its contrast against the other slot is at least 4.5:1, else the palette value.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

pairings.note: Restrained serif or thin sans, set small and low in the lower third; film-title style.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

type.load: In a HyperFrames composition add the two <link> tags from `google` to <head> (plus rel=preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com), set font-family from `css`, and wait for document.fonts.ready before the first screenshot / timeline build. Offline renders: download the families once (they are OFL) into the project's fonts/ folder and use @font-face. The brand face always sets the real claim line and the product UI text; the style pairing is for the world's chrome and display.
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text. Under a brand lock keep the brand face for the claim and use the pairing's display for labels only.

finish.how: Runtime: RasanFX.create({ source, passes: [...] }) from runtime/rasan-fx.js, applied in the listed order, on the whole composition canvas or on the Codex plate only (plate-only when the type must stay crisp). `css` lists the cheap approximation kinds story boards and style frames draw with plain CSS (grain:<opacity>, scan:<opacity>, halftone, pixel, led-dots ...).

composition.grid: 2.39:1 letterbox inside 16:9; subject on a third with leading space; layered foreground, mid, background haze
composition.safe_area: safe area 8%; type in the lower-left third
composition.fill: subject 25-45%; the world is the hero, the rest is atmosphere
composition.product_ui: UI is a practical screen in the scene (a laptop, a phone, a wall display) lit by its own glow; the capture is composited on the plate

codex.template: {subject} {action}, {setting}. Camera and lens: 35 mm anamorphic lens, f/2.8, slight handheld, low horizon, shallow depth of field with oval bokeh. Lighting: motivated practical lights (lamp, window), low-key, volumetric haze, warm key against teal shadows. Material: real-world surfaces: weathered concrete, wet asphalt, linen, brushed metal, with natural imperfections. Colour, locked to the palette {palette_words}, and nothing outside it. Texture and finish: fine 35 mm grain, light halation on highlights, soft lens flare streak. Avoid: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no text, no logos, no AI plastic skin, no extra fingers, no symmetrical staging, no over-sharpened detail, nobody looking at the camera.
codex.camera: 35 mm anamorphic lens, f/2.8, slight handheld, low horizon, shallow depth of field with oval bokeh
codex.lighting: motivated practical lights (lamp, window), low-key, volumetric haze, warm key against teal shadows
codex.material: real-world surfaces: weathered concrete, wet asphalt, linen, brushed metal, with natural imperfections
codex.colour_rule: Name the palette's colours in words (the palette's `words`), never hex codes; add 'and nothing outside this palette'. Pick one palette per film and keep it.
codex.texture: fine 35 mm grain, light halation on highlights, soft lens flare streak

aspect.note: Plates: ask for about 12% bleed around the frame so the camera can travel; keep the calm side empty for type. Generate 16:9 for the frame, 1:1 for sprite sheets and objects.

consistency.anchor: Make the anchor plate first, approve it by eye, then pass it as --ref to every other image (imagegen batch does this with --world).
consistency.style_line: Append the world bible's style line (30-45 words, no hex) to every prompt.
consistency.seed_words: Keep these words verbatim in every prompt of the film: real-world surfaces: weathered concrete; 35 mm anamorphic lens; deep teal shadows, warm bone white, amber light, teal.

sprite_sheet.rules: Not a sprite style. For a cut-out object or character use --transparent (flat #00FF00 key, then despill); one subject, no shadow plane.

do: Motivate every light source in the frame
Keep one world: same lens, same grade, same grain across shots
Leave room: wide shots, long holds, slow push-ins
dont: No more than one hero subject
cheap_ways: Orange-teal grade slapped on stock-looking AI frames
